mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a commercially viable egg producing bird."
A layer is a commercially viable egg producing bird.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a good indication of where the hens are in the production cycle."
pigmentation is a good indication of where the hens are in the production cycle.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the largest known bird and some scientists believe that the present bird developed from ancestors that were capable of flight."
The ostrich is the largest known bird and some scientists believe that the present bird developed from ancestors that were capable of flight.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used in large egg production complexes, but these birds typically do not produce well in home flocks."
The commercial White Leghorn is used in large egg production complexes, but these birds typically do not produce well in home flocks.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the result of two yolks being released at the same time."
A double-yolked egg is the result of two yolks being released at the same time.
